'''Kli-Klu Niib''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] ringer working for the casino of the [[Sanads of Rorkee]] hotel.

Niib had a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] implanted on the back of his [[Limb/Legends|hand]] to perform arithmetical operations while gambling, and so take advantage of the probabilities. Although unusual, this was not illegal.

Niib was known to be a serious person who disliked talking about himself.

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Niib noticed a guest of the hotel, Dr. [[Shilaea Motacc]], and decided she was a very nice person. Niib was both surprised and disappointed when Motacc apparently died in a supposed cave-in in the [[Dorumaa Excavation]] simulation &mdash; particularly as he believed accidents could not have happened there.
